रागा

RĀGĀ . One of the seven daughters of bṛhaspati--aṅgiras. As she was loved by all beings she came to be called rāgā. (Vana Parva, Chapter 203).

रागखाण्डव

RĀGAKHĀṆḌAVA . A cake-like thing formed in a yajña performed by King dilīpa. (droṇa parva, Chapter 61, Verse 8).

रागिणी

RĀGIṆĪ . A celestial woman, daughter of himavān and elder sister of pārvatī. (For details see under pārvatī).
